metadata.description: Deterministic offline fixtures for the Critical-Path Procurement Consequence Agent. Activated by IBD_TESTING=1. Seed scenario: supplier LIFNR-0010045 silent for 11 days on structural-steel PO 4500000123, on the critical path of project P-INFRA-07 (Level-3 slab pour).

s4-sourcing-procurement.description: S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement reads (EKKO/EKPO/EKBE/EBAN/PRPS/AFKO/AFVV/MLST/KONP/EORD/LFM1) plus Ariba contract and HANA Vector Engine retrieval.

get_open_pr_po_chain.description: Retrieve the full PR->PO->confirmation chain for a material/project/supplier: PR approval status, PO issuance date, delivery due date, last confirmation; builds the end-to-end delay narrative. Reads Info Record lead-time (PLIFZ).

get_approval_workflow_status.description: Check SAP workflow release status for open PRs/POs: approver identity, time-in-step; maps FRGKZ release indicator to approver roles.

detect_supplier_silence.description: Derive supplier silence duration from the last order-acknowledgement event (EKBE VGABE=1) per PO plus external email timestamps; composite silence score. Supplements with Info Record expected-ack window (PLIFZ).

get_source_and_contract_dependencies.description: Approved source-of-supply entries from the Source List (EORD) + Info Record, plus Ariba contract terms. Returns alternative approved vendors with validity and fixed-source flag.

get_procurement_contract_terms.description: Penalty clause amounts, liquidated-damages schedules, and force-majeure terms from the Ariba Contract Workspace (KONP.KBETR -> milestone at risk).

link_po_to_project_wbs.description: Join open PO items (EKPO account assignment) -> PRPS -> AFKO/AFVV/MLST to find dependent deliverables; returns network float and milestone dependencies.

get_vendor_delivery_performance.description: Vendor delivery metrics from EKBE/EKPO/LFM1 (late-delivery frequency, EINDT vs BUDAT delta, payment-term variance) -> supplier_delivery_risk_score 0-100. Optional external risk-feed enrichment (labelled simulated).

rag_retrieve_contract_and_history.description: Semantic + metadata-filtered retrieval over the HANA Cloud Vector Engine (penalty clauses, prior escalations, alt-source justifications), filtered by contract id / LIFNR / MATNR / WERKS. Returns chunks with similarity scores; caller applies the >=0.82 gate.

value.text: Liquidated damages of EUR 5,000 per calendar day of late delivery apply to critical-path structural steel, capped at EUR 40,000 per milestone.
Supplier LIFNR-0010045 went silent on structural steel in Feb 2026; resolved only after manual escalation at day 14. Alternative LIFNR-0010099 delivered within 18 days.
General payment-term variance note (below similarity gate — excluded).
